nodes.title: SoftMotion Sports Bra

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Sports Bras

nodes.descriptionHtml:
SoftMotion Sports Bra brings a clean, scoop-neck shape to your activewear wardrobe. The cropped silhouette pairs with high-waisted leggings or shorts and works as a simple base for a layered outfit.

  • Sleeveless sports-bra silhouette with wide shoulder straps.
  • Black and Gray color choices.
  • Sizes XS, S, M, L and XL.

Choose your color and size before adding to your bag. Matching bottoms and accessories shown in photographs are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A scoop-neck sports bra with a clean cropped silhouette, available in Black and Gray.

nodes.title: EasyLift Halter Bralette

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Sports Bras

nodes.descriptionHtml:
EasyLift Halter Bralette combines a halter neckline with a cropped activewear silhouette. Its open shoulder line and defined underband create a simple look worn alone or beneath an open jacket.

  • Halter-style neckline.
  • Cropped bralette shape.
  • Burgundy and Taupe color choices.

Pair with your preferred leggings or shorts. Other garments and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A cropped halter bralette in Burgundy or Taupe, with an open shoulder line and defined underband.

nodes.title: Mellow Soft Long Sleeve Top

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Activewear Tops

nodes.descriptionHtml:
Mellow Soft Long Sleeve Top has a fitted, cropped shape with a crew neckline and full-length sleeves. The Charcoal color makes it easy to style with leggings, shorts or relaxed trousers.

  • Crew neckline.
  • Long sleeves and cropped hem.
  • Charcoal color, matching the source product photograph.

Wear on its own or add a layer to suit your day. Bottoms and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A fitted Charcoal long-sleeve top with a crew neckline and cropped hem.

nodes.title: SoftMotion Jacket

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Activewear Vests & Jackets

nodes.descriptionHtml:
SoftMotion Jacket adds a fitted layer to an activewear outfit. A full-length front zip lets you wear the collar open or closed, while the shaped seams follow the jacket's silhouette.

  • Zip-front closure and stand collar.
  • Long sleeves.
  • Taupe and Olive color choices.

Layer over a sports bra or top and pair with your preferred bottoms. Other garments and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A fitted zip-front activewear jacket with a stand collar, available in Taupe and Olive.

nodes.title: Effortless Seamless Leggings

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Activewear Pants > Leggings

nodes.descriptionHtml:
Effortless Seamless Leggings bring a high-waisted, full-length silhouette to your activewear rotation. A close-fitting shape pairs easily with cropped tops, sports bras and a zip-front jacket.

  • High waistband.
  • Full-length leg.
  • Burgundy and Black color choices.

Tops, footwear and accessories shown in photographs are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: High-waisted, full-length leggings in Burgundy or Black with a close-fitting silhouette.

nodes.title: Unified High Waisted Shorts

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Activewear Pants > Shorts

nodes.descriptionHtml:
Unified High Waisted Shorts feature a close-fitting silhouette with a high waistband and short leg. Wear them with a sports bra, cropped top or lightweight layer.

  • High-waisted shape.
  • Short activewear silhouette.
  • Taupe and Black color options.

Tops, footwear and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: Close-fitting, high-waisted activewear shorts with a short leg and shaped waistband.

nodes.title: High Neck Sports Bra

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Sports Bras

nodes.descriptionHtml:
High Neck Sports Bra pairs a high neckline with an open shoulder line and a cropped hem. The Pink color gives this activewear piece a simple, tonal look.

  • Sleeveless, cropped silhouette.
  • Pink color.

Bottoms and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A Pink high-neck sports bra with a cropped, sleeveless silhouette.

nodes.title: Square Neck Long Sleeve Crop Top

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Activewear Tops

nodes.descriptionHtml:
Square Neck Long Sleeve Crop Top combines full-length sleeves with a short, cropped hem. The wide square neckline creates an open shape for layering over your preferred sports bra.

  • Square neckline.
  • Long sleeves.
  • White color and cropped silhouette.

Sports bra, bottoms and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A White long-sleeve crop top with a wide square neckline.

nodes.title: Twist Front Sports Bra

category.fullName: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Activewear > Sports Bras

nodes.descriptionHtml:
Twist Front Sports Bra features a V neckline and a gathered twist at the center front. A small cutout below the twist adds detail to its cropped Black silhouette.

  • V neckline and twist-front detail.
  • Small center-front cutout.
  • Black color.

Bottoms and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A Black sports bra with a twist-front detail, V neckline and small front cutout.

Ruched Long Sleeve Crop Top combines a wide neckline with gathered detail at the center front. Its long sleeves balance a cropped hem for an easy activewear look.

  • Light blue color.

Bottoms and accessories shown are sold separately. Refer to the garment label for fabric composition and care instructions.

summary.value: A Light blue long-sleeve crop top with a wide neckline and ruched center front.
